name: Nangou Tsukimi
source:
Tsukimi is a delinquent, causes often trouble and a bit of a bullish girl. Though a bit violent, Tsukimi is actually a gentle and friendly girl. She loves driving, with all the experience of driving different vehicles, she calls herself the  “Emperor of the Unlicensed”. Because her parents were famous sailors and never came home, she thought they abandoned. She doesn't get along with Erna.

[Edited from [url=https://dnandre.wordpress.com/2012/05/02/galge-preview-dolphin-divers/]dnandre's review[/url])
